geometry.note: Context building and a candidate anchor for the Mu2e entry in the map's unlocated list; it is not confirmed to be the Mu2e hall.

method: OpenStreetMap way 720556732 'MC-2' footprint, traced verbatim, 84 m from MC-1 (way 720556725, confirmed as the Muon g-2 building). Drawn as a context feature (entity_id null, not detector:mu2e) because no source consulted confirms MC-2 is specifically the Mu2e hall; the MC-1/MC-2 naming pattern and Muon Campus adjacency are suggestive but not sourced. As of 2026-09-18 a web search and two attempts to read the arXiv paper 'Muon Campus at Fermilab' (arXiv:2208.02889, HTML and PDF) found no text naming MC-2, and its HTML text contains no mention of it on 2026-10-25.
name: MC-2 building, Fermilab Muon Campus (identity not confirmed)
notes: No source consulted (checked 2026-10-25) names this building or gives its construction date. Its label belongs to the Muon Campus building series; the MC-1 building was proposed when the Muon Campus program was set up in 2012 (U.S. Department of Energy determination CX-010394, dated 12 June 2012, which does not mention MC-2). The earliest evidence that the building stands is its first appearance in OpenStreetMap on 31 August 2019, so it is drawn from August 2019; that date is when it was traced, not when it was built.
No site is attached: the identification of MC-2 with the Mu2e hall is not confirmed (see the map's unlocated entry for detector:mu2e), so this building is not drawn as site:fermilab-mu2e-hall.

summary.plain: A building labelled MC-2 in OpenStreetMap, 84 m from the MC-1 (Muon g-2) building on the Fermilab Muon Campus. No source consulted identifies it or dates it; it is drawn from August 2019, when it first appears in OpenStreetMap. It is not confirmed to be the Mu2e hall.
